result.summary: Found 2 major layout issues: content is truncated/cut off horizontally in the 'Fastest near you' section and vertically at the bottom of the page, preventing users from viewing complete restaurant information.

issues.description: The third restaurant card in 'Fastest near you' section (Trattoria Piccol) is cut off horizontally and not fully visible
issues.suggestion: Ensure proper horizontal scrolling or adjust card width/spacing so all cards are fully visible or properly scrollable without truncation

issues.description: The bottom restaurant card in 'Popular right now' section is cut off vertically, making the restaurant name and details partially invisible
issues.suggestion: Adjust vertical spacing or implement proper scrolling to ensure all restaurant cards are completely visible without being cut off at the bottom of the viewport
